Health codes globally prohibit bringing live poultry into food-preparation areas. - **Respect for ownership:** The chicken belongs to your sister. Always prioritize the animal’s well-being and the owner’s wishes over impulsive " helpful" actions. If you care about the chicken, ask your sister how she prefers to handle its needs. 💡
